title: 第6589章 炼化雷城第6588章 我现在就拒绝你了
slug: 吞噬古帝第6589章炼化雷城
lines: 问道皇站在虚空雷城正中央的虚空。
而位先知王，则是分别傲立于虚空雷城的四周，一个个脸色很是凝重。
至于先知族的其他护法，则是在远处劫杀想要进入虚空雷城的人。
不管发生什么事情，都不能让此事泄露出去。
不是怕。
而是不愿意，也不能。
这是道德问题，就算是先知族都不愿意碰触。
哪怕先知族的实力摆在那里，在威慑下没有人敢说什么，但他们还是不愿意让先知族成为大陆公敌。
有些事情，不能泄露。
“开始！”
随着问道皇一声令下。
不管是否愿意，所有先知王开始全部调动全部的力量，股恐怖的力量从四周全部覆盖了整个虚空雷池。
而坐镇正中央位置的问道皇，作为堂堂的永生境强者，手里则是出现问道剑，剑指苍穹！
“我会超度你们所有人。”
手握的问道剑，直接朝着虚空斩出一剑。
嗡！
伴随着剑吟咆哮，霸道无比的问道剑，作为媒介，融合股先知王的力量，开始疯狂的降临下来。
“怎么回事，我的身体不能动了。”
“好恐怖的力量，我的身体不仅动，反而我的元神都要爆裂了。”
“是谁想要灭杀我。”
砰！
砰！
砰！
在恐怖的力量镇压下，一位位武者的身体不断的爆裂，就算是大帝武者都抗衡不住，因为先知族不单单是汇聚这些强者的力量，更是动用了先知族的顶级至宝，其中更是有着问道剑。
正准备开启空间阵法的苏辰，突然感受到特殊的力量涌来，他之前感应到先知族的强者气息，当然知道这股力量意味着什么。
先知族锁定了自己。
苏辰第一时间便知道发生了什么事情。
单单是靠着空间阵法，自己肯定是无法活着离开，他很清楚先知族想要杀自己的心不会改变。
立刻召唤出穿界舟和鸿蒙造化舟，自己先是进入穿界舟，然后穿界舟进入鸿蒙造化舟。
这样的话，就算是先知族炼化整个虚空雷城，相信应该是无法炼化两舟叠加。
够狠！
苏辰当然明白先知族想要做什么，为了斩杀自己，甚至不惜牺牲整个虚空雷城。
在先知族众人眼里，虚空雷城根本不算什么.
原本苏辰想要带着戎汐一起离开，因为苏辰很清楚，戎汐在先知族的镇压下，必死无疑。
但。
他想救是一回事，是否能够救又是另外一回事。
content_en:
Emperor Dao stood in the void in the center of Void Thunder City.
The prophet kings stood proudly around the Void Thunder City, with serious expressions on their faces.
As for the other guardians of the Prophet clan, they robbed and killed those who wanted to enter the Void Thunder City from a distance.
No matter what happens, this cannot be allowed to leak out.
Not afraid.
But unwilling and unable.
This is a moral issue that even the Prophets are unwilling to touch.
Even though the strength of the Prophet Clan is there and no one dares to say anything under intimidation, they are still unwilling to let the Prophet Clan become the public enemy of the mainland.
Some things cannot be revealed.
"Start!"
Following the Emperor Dao's order.
Regardless of whether they were willing or not, all the prophet kings began to mobilize all their power, and a terrifying force covered the entire void thunder pool from all sides.
As for the Taoist Emperor sitting in the center, as a dignified and powerful person in the Immortal Realm, the Taoist Sword appeared in his hand, pointing at the sky!
"I will deliver all of you."
The Taoist Sword in his hand slashed directly into the void.
Buzz!
Along with the roar of the sword, the extremely domineering Dao Jian, as a medium, combined with the power of the Prophet King, began to descend crazily.
"What's going on? I can't move my body."
"What a terrifying power. Not only does my body move, but my spirit is about to burst."
"Who wants to kill me?"
Bang!
Bang!
Bang!
Under the suppression of the terrifying power, the bodies of each warrior continued to explode. Even the emperor warriors could not resist it, because the Prophet Clan not only gathered the power of these powerful men, but also used the top treasures of the Prophet Clan, including the Taoist Sword.
Su Chen, who was about to activate the space formation, suddenly felt a special power coming. He had sensed the strong aura of the prophet clan before, so of course he knew what this power meant.
The Prophets locked themselves.
Su Chen knew what happened immediately.
Just relying on the space formation, he would definitely not be able to leave alive. He knew very well that the Prophet clan's intention to kill him would not change.
Immediately summon the world-crossing boat and the Hongmeng creation boat. He first entered the world-crossing boat, and then the world-crossing boat entered the Hongmeng creation boat.
In this case, even if the Prophet clan refines the entire Void Thunder City, I believe they will not be able to refine two boats on top of each other.
Cruel enough!
Of course, Su Chen understood what the Prophet clan wanted to do. In order to kill him, he would even sacrifice the entire Void Thunder City.
In the eyes of the Prophet clan, Void Thunder City is nothing at all.
Originally, Su Chen wanted to leave with Rong tide, because Su Chen knew very well that Rong tide would definitely die under the suppression of the Prophet clan.
but.
It's one thing if he wants to save, but another if he can save.
